<!--
Template for the API pages. scripts/make_pages.R creates one page per API
in api/, which sets `api_id` and includes this file.
-->

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
status <- read_status()
apis <- read_apis()
api <- apis$apis[[match(api_id, vapply(apis$apis, `[[`, "", "id"))]]
eps <- endpoint_table(api)
users <- api_packages(api, status)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
md(api$description %||% "")
md("Base url: `", api$base_url, "`",
   if (!is.null(api$website)) paste0(" · [Website](", api$website, ")"))
md("Checked ", updated(apis), ". ",
   if (!is.null(api$baseline_recorded)) paste0("Responses are compared with the baseline recorded on ", substr(api$baseline_recorded, 1, 10), ".")
   else "There is no baseline yet, so changes can not be detected.")
```

## Used by

```{r}
#| results: asis
md("**Directly:** ", if (length(users$direct)) paste(package_link(users$direct, status, from = "api"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
md("**Through a dependency:** ", if (length(users$via)) paste(package_link(users$via, status, from = "api"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
```

## Endpoints

```{r}
#| results: asis
md_table(
  data.frame(
    Endpoint = sprintf("[%s](#%s)", eps$name, gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(eps$name))),
    Status = vapply(eps$status, function(s) as.character(badge(api_status_label[[s]], api_status_colour[[s]])), ""),
    HTTP = eps$http_status,
    `Time (s)` = eps$time_s,
    `Size (kB)` = eps$size_kb,
    Records = eps$records,
    Fields = eps$fields,
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  align = "llrrrrr"
)
```

## Changes since the baseline

```{r}
#| results: asis
changes <- unlist(lapply(api$endpoints, function(e) {
  vapply(e$changes, function(ch) paste0("**", e$name, "**: ", ch$text), "")
}))
errors <- unlist(lapply(api$endpoints, function(e) if (!is.null(e$error)) paste0("**", e$name, "**: ", e$error)))
md_list(c(errors, changes), empty = "No changes: every endpoint returns the same structure as the baseline.")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in api$endpoints) {
  md("## ", e$name, ' {#', gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(e$name)), '}')
  md("`", e$url, "`")
  md("Called by: ", paste0("`", unlist(e$functions), "()`", collapse = ", "))
  info <- c(
    if (!is.null(e$http_status)) paste("HTTP", e$http_status),
    if (!is.null(e$content_type) && nzchar(e$content_type)) e$content_type,
    if (!is.null(e$time_s)) paste(e$time_s, "s"),
    if (!is.null(e$records)) paste(e$records, "records")
  )
  if (length(info)) md(paste(info, collapse = " · "))
  if (length(e$fields)) {
    md('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Response structure: ', length(e$fields), ' fields"}')
    md_table(data.frame(
      Field = paste0("`", names(e$fields), "`"),
      Type = vapply(e$fields, function(t) paste(unlist(t), collapse = " | "), "")
    ), row.names = FALSE)
    md(":::")
  }
}
```
